UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile containing synchronized watchlist and watch history.

email.description: The user's registered Google email address.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

role.description: user or admin status for authorization.

watchlist.description: List of movie/show IDs the user saved.

history.description: Historic items watched with progress indicators.

MediaRequest.title: MediaRequest
MediaRequest.description: A movie or series request submitted by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the request document.

title.description: Title of the requested movie or TV series.

type.description: Type of media, either movie or tv.

category.description: The genre or category of the media.

status.description: Status of the request (pending, approved, rejected).

userId.description: User ID of the individual who made the request.

userEmail.description: Email of the individual who made the request.

userName.description: Display name of the user who made the request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the request was created.

adminNotes.description: Feedback notes left by an administrator.

users/{userId}.description: Collection storing personalized profile, watchlist, and play history, restricted for access.

requests/{requestId}.description: Collection for custom movie and tv series requests submitted by users.
